title: chu-space
description: A triple (A, r, X) — states A, attributes X, evaluation r: A × X → L — generalizing a formal context. Chu spaces form a *-autonomous category (the model of linear logic): tensor ⊗ and linear implication ⊸. Chu(H,0) over a Heyting algebra is the twist construction producing the bilattice. The categorical construction over a monoidal category that adds a dualizing object.

evaluation.description: r : A × X → L into a value set L (generalizes a formal context's incidence)

star-autonomous.description: Chu spaces over L form a *-autonomous category — ⊗ ⊣ ⊸, self-dual; the model of linear logic
